title: Page 37
transc:
Geo H Smith St Louis Mo  Washington April 12th 1864
Growl April flood For Moscow Unity Your report of
Whig shows over gas publish teams Sligo Quadroon Zebra
It is impossible to supply the tartar Wherry for
the Oysters in Adonis in time for spring opera
shuns Zodiac Can you not send the mules of
plaster publish of your teams to Dragon at once
sugar Send all you can yoke Japan


G T Sheldon Ft. Monroe  New York Apl 12 / 64
Astor House N York April twelve for
Gen Butler Ft Monroe Your dispatch received here
say to French Officers that I
authorize delay until I see French
charge at Washn I shall arrive
at Washn tomorrow morning and I
will give final direction there signed
Wm H Seward 430 PM clear warm beautiful afternoon


Washn April 13th 1864
G. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Reliance For Knave Unity I can send
you pandora Kautz to Pontiac your Panama
Quincy He is a good Pacific officer
Do you want him sent sugar Juno
